The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Network Session ASIM parser for Halcyon
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 4001                                    // OCSF Network Activity (4001 only; DNS 4003 handled separately)
    | extend
        SrcHostname_raw = tostring(src_endpoint.hostname),       // OCSF maps asset -> src_endpoint (no separate device object for 4001)
        DvcId           = tostring(src_endpoint.uid),
        DstIpAddr       = tostring(dst_endpoint.ip),             // populated only for peer-reputation events; empty for outbound-volume events
        SrcIpAddr       = tostring(src_endpoint.ip),             // not emitted by Halcyon 4001 today; future-proofed (empty for now)
        _bytes_out      = tolong(traffic.bytes_out),             // populated only for outbound-volume events
        _dur_secs       = toreal(traffic['timespan'].duration_secs),// populated only for outbound-volume events ('timespan' bracketed - reserved KQL keyword)
        SrcProcessId    = tostring(actor.process.pid),           // actor.process = connection initiator (the source process)
        SrcProcessName  = tostring(actor.process.file.path),
        SrcUsername     = tostring(actor.['user'].name),
        SrcUserId       = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('SrcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        NetworkBytes = _bytes_out,
        SrcBytes     = _bytes_out,                               // bytes_out is source-originated (outbound) volume
        NetworkDuration = iff(isnull(_dur_secs), int(null), toint(_dur_secs * 1000)),   // seconds -> milliseconds
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Duration     = NetworkDuration,
        EventEndTime = iff(isnull(_dur_secs), EventStartTime, EventStartTime + (_dur_secs * 1s)),
        Dst          = DstIpAddr,
        SrcHostname  = DvcHostname,
        Src          = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, DvcHostname),        // prefer IP if Halcyon emits it later; falls back to resolved hostname (== SrcHostname; referenced directly as SrcHostname is assigned in this same extend)
        IpAddr       = SrcIpAddr,                               // required ASIM alias of SrcIpAddr
        Hostname     = DvcHostname,
        SrcDvcId     = DvcId,
        SrcDvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        DvcIdType    = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        Dvc          = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname),
        // Both event types in this class are outbound by definition (egress volume and peer-reputation egress).
        NetworkDirection = "Outbound",
        // Security verdict drives EventResult/DvcAction, NOT status_id. Block (action_id 2) => Failure/Deny, Report (action_id 1) => Success/Allow.
        // NetworkSession DvcAction enum has no "Block"; "Deny" is the enforced-block value (matches CiscoASA convention).
        EventResult = case(action_id == 2, "Failure", action_id == 1, "Success", "NA"),
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Deny", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventResultDetails = "NA",                              // NetworkSession enum has no "Other"; "NA" = no network-level result reason (verdict is in EventResult/DvcAction)
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        Process          = SrcProcessName,
        User             = SrcUsername,
        SrcUsernameType  = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        SrcUserType      = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        SrcUserIdType    = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other")
    | extend
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "NetworkSession",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.7",
        EventType    = "EndpointNetworkSession",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind),
                              "halcyon_threshold",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_threshold),
                              "halcyon_dxp_rule",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_dxp_rule)
                          )
    | project-away SrcHostname_raw, _bytes_out, _dur_secs
};
parser(disabled=disabled)
